lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Cadet: I want the whole package.

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Commander: I'm ready for a challenge.

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: What's your name, specialist?

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Tilt your device or use the cursor

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Message from Earth. Sent {DELAY} minutes ago.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Welcome, {PLAYER}. I'm Sam, your flight director here on Earth.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Robots on the Moon and Mars are getting things ready for the next astronauts.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: But four of them stopped sending signals. We don't know why yet.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: You're our robot specialist. Your job: find them and fix them.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: First stop: the Moon. Let's see what you learned in training.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Moon base online. Our signal delay is only 1.3 seconds.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: That means I can help you almost live. Let's use it!

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Every day starts with energy. Split it between life support, radio and shielding.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Up here, nothing is free. Everything you do costs something.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Try giving life support the most. Your crew needs air and water first. Don't forget the oxygen.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Moon dust is sharp and sticky. It's covering the cables in your solar panels.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Connect the cables to fix them. Working panels make more energy.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: That's it. Let's go back.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Your oxygen tank fills when you are inside the station.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: I hear a weak signal. Point the antenna at it.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Tilt to steer. Driving uses energy, so take the short way.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: When the signal turns green, hold still.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Got it! That's Pragyan. Take the rover and go find it.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: There it is. Open its file and let's see what's wrong.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Let's connect the cables and point the panel so it faces the sun.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: It's beeping again! Great work, {PLAYER}.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Pragyan gave you something for your trip: an extra battery.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Did you know? On the Moon, the Sun stays up for about two weeks. Then it's night for two weeks.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Can you imagine how a base could stay warm during that long night?

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: You're ready for Mars. Pack your energy, water and air for the trip.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: This time your crew will be with you.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Pack too little and you'll arrive short. Pack too much and the ship gets heavy.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Grab the rover keys. Let's go find that signal.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Pragyan gave you something for your trip.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: An extra battery! You'll need it on Mars.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Mars is far. The trip takes months, so we'll skip to the good part.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Tilt to keep the ship on its path. Every fix uses a little fuel.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: One more thing. From now on, my messages will take minutes to reach you.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: But don't worry, you won't be alone. The base AI will help you. Good luck, {PLAYER}.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Hi, {PLAYER}! I'm your Planetary Interface Partner, but you can call me PIP. I run the base, watch the oxygen and tell jokes.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Two of those I'm very good at.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Welcome to Mars! Here a day is called a sol. It lasts 24 hours and 39 minutes.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: This is your crew. They count on you for air, water and food from the greenhouse.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Three robots on Mars stopped talking. Sam sent their files. You pick who to help first.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Tip: tap the robot and read each file. It says how that robot can help us.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: You made it! I can't answer fast anymore. Trust PIP, and trust yourself.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: So basically if I tell Sam a joke now, Sam laughs in {DELAY} minutes. Which is still worth it.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Curiosity went quiet after a big solar storm.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Another storm may be coming. Check DONKI before you go outside.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: DONKI is NASA's space weather database. It tracks storms that come from the Sun.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Here on Mars, we must be careful when going outside.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Let's check the forecast on DONKI.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Solar storm ahead. Good thing I wear sunscreen. ...I'm a computer. I don't.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Mars has very thin air and no magnetic shield like Earth's. More radiation gets through.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Let's make our shielding stronger before we leave.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Tip: shielding costs energy. Do it the sol before the storm.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: The storm passed. It's safe to drive now.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Mars dust gets everywhere. I found some in my code.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Here's Curiosity. Its file says: a solar storm scrambled its computer and left it in safe mode. Let's fix it.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Connect the device to the robot to access the terminal.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Curiosity uses 2 computers. Stop the broken one, and start the other computer.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Curiosity is back! It will warn us about storms one sol earlier.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Checking the forecast was the right call. Real teams do it every day.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Did you know? Earth's magnetic field blocks a lot of space radiation. Mars doesn't have one like it.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Do you think that's what makes the northern lights on Earth?

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Phoenix was searching for ice under the ground. Then it stopped.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Your crew needs water too. Keep the tanks full before you go.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: We can recycle water or dig for ice. Recycling costs less. Ice gives more.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: This water has been recycled so many times, it deserves a medal.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Remember: the greenhouse needs water too. No water, no salad.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Tip: keep life support above half before you drive out.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Here's Phoenix. Its file says: hard ice jammed its scoop, and sticky dirt clogged its oven screen. Let's fix it.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Phoenix found ice again! We'll get extra water every sol.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Fresh lettuce on Mars! Lettuce celebrate.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Well, that sounds nice.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Did you know? The Space Station recycles about 98 of every 100 drops of water.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Can you find out where Mars keeps its ice? It could be useful in future missions.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: A dust storm is covering the sky. Opportunity went dark, and your panels are getting weak.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Keep the base warm first. Then go find Opportunity.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Sunlight on Mars is less than half as strong as on Earth. With dust, it's even weaker.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: We can repair the panels, or start the small reactor. The reactor takes two sols.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: I'm not lazy. I'm in power-saving mode.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Tip: start the reactor early. It's slow, but it works in any weather.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Here's Opportunity. Its file says: a dust storm covered its solar panels.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Have you tried turning it off and on again? Oh wait. That's literally our job.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Opportunity is online! The base gets extra energy every sol.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Did you know? NASA is working on small nuclear reactors to power future bases on the Moon and Mars.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Can you imagine how long the biggest dust storms on Mars can last?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Energy is getting low. Let's save some for tonight.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Air and water are dropping. The crew needs you to fix that first.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Our shielding is weak. Maybe stay inside until we fix it.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Food is running low. The greenhouse needs water to grow more.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Uh-oh. We ran out of air and water.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Uh-oh. We ran out of food.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Uh-oh. We ran out of shielding.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: The crew shared their reserves to help us. We lost a sol, but everyone is okay.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Let's plan a little better this time. You've got this!

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Mission paused: you ran out of air and water.

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Mission paused: you ran out of food.

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Mission paused: you ran out of shielding.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: We had to bring the crew inside. Here's what happened: the air and water ran out before we could refill them.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: We had to bring the crew inside. Here's what happened: the crew ate more than the greenhouse could grow.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: We had to bring the crew inside. Here's what happened: the shielding got too low, and too much radiation got through.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Every astronaut learns from a tough sol. Want to try again?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: That's all of them, {PLAYER}! Every robot is talking again.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: {PLAYER}, we got signals from all four robots. Everyone here is cheering.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Thanks to you, the next crew can come to Mars. You're not a cadet anymore.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: I'd hug you, but I don't have arms. Consider this a virtual hug.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Want to try a different order? Or switch to Commander mode?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Hard ice is stuck in Phoenix's scoop.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Tap the ice and dirt with the hammer to break them off!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Tip: ice needs 3 hits. Dirt needs only 1.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Sticky dirt is clogging Phoenix's oven screen.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Tap fast, press SPACE, or shake your device to clean it!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: The real Phoenix team shook its screen for several days.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Dust is covering Opportunity's solar panels.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Hold and swipe over the panels to brush the dust away!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Tip: just clicking won't work. You have to swipe.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Opportunity's battery cables came loose.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Drag each cable to the socket of the same color!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Tip: each cable and socket has a letter too.

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Pack for Mars

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Life support (air + water)

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Food

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Ship weight

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Light: you'll arrive short.

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Good balance!

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Heavy: steering will use more fuel.

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Launch!

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Fuel

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Mars

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Tilt your device to steer.

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Drag your finger or use the arrows to steer.

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Tap to start

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: On path

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Off path! Steer back.

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: You reached Mars!

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Packed: +{0} life support, +{1} food

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Off path: the crew used {0} on the longer trip.

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Perfect path! Nothing lost.

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: You ran out of fuel. A lighter ship uses less.

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: Tap to continue

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: Practice time! Tap + and - to share 10 energy.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: A new sol! Let's share today's energy.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Food only grows if air & water is 20 or more!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Good job! The crew is safe for now.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Some sunlight was wasted. Use your energy or lose it!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: A storm hit our shield. DONKI can warn us next time.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Something is running low. Give it more energy today!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: The crew can only do this once. Let's be careful!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Oh no. The crew has no reserves left to share.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Our time on Mars is over. Let's see what we fixed!
